items.q: Why does she reject buy-a-house as the default?
items.a: In Ramsey's lifetime, wages rose about **2×** and housing about **9×**. Austin, on her figure, is down about **30%**. Buffett: be greedy when others are fearful. An NFT fell from **$60 million to $19,000**.

items.q: When is a credit card the better tool?
items.a: When you **pay it off**. Interest and buying wants make cards bad. **Debit is worse** on the protections and the record. Debt belongs on **assets**.

About **90%** of startups fail over five years. A cited study: about **33% higher** odds of success **with an income**, because you decide outside fight-or-flight. Passive income as money for nothing is a **lie**. A tax category is real.
**Vanguard**, a low-cost fund that does not trade a lot, the **S&P 500** inside a diversified portfolio. She says skip Robinhood and single stocks until you know the game.
